goal: Real Google sign-in on vii.spaplus.co using an isolated Google Cloud project and secure secrets

applicable_lessons.title: מסירה דורשת תוצאה מלאה ובדיקת רגרסיה

requirements.statement: Real Google sign-in on vii.spaplus.co using an isolated Google Cloud project and secure secrets
requirements.acceptance_check: A real Google account completes OAuth on vii.spaplus.co, returns to the site with a secure authenticated session, survives refresh, supports logout, and no credential is committed to Git

requirements.statement: מוצר או אתר אינם גמורים כאשר קיימים כפתורים מתים, מצבים מזויפים, מסלולים קטועים או חיבורים שלא נבדקו מקצה לקצה.
requirements.acceptance_check: A release checklist fails when a requested flow has a dead control, fabricated state, unverified integration or missing responsive evidence, and passes only after the complete flow is retested.

requirements.statement: Only Google Cloud project vii-website-auth is changed
requirements.acceptance_check: Only Google Cloud project vii-website-auth is changed

requirements.statement: Client secret is stored only in the hosting secret store and never in source or test output
requirements.acceptance_check: Client secret is stored only in the hosting secret store and never in source or test output

requirements.statement: Login success, cancellation, failure, refresh and logout are verified on the deployed temporary domain on desktop and 390px mobile
requirements.acceptance_check: Login success, cancellation, failure, refresh and logout are verified on the deployed temporary domain on desktop and 390px mobile
